summary: Chunghwa Telecom furnished a Form 6-K carrying its November 4, 2026 press release of unaudited third-quarter 2026 consolidated results under T-IFRS. Revenue rose 16.7% year over year to NT$67.59 billion, operating income 27.1% to NT$15.38 billion, EBITDA 16.1% to NT$25.66 billion, and net income attributable to parent shareholders 29.5% to NT$12.22 billion, with basic EPS of NT$1.57. Management said revenue, profit and EPS exceeded the high end of quarterly guidance, aided by a one-off asset-revitalization gain. No transaction, stake, price or board recommendation is disclosed; watch for guidance confirmation.
